crossRefs.note: Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.
You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.
Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
translations.bsb: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
translations.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
translations.asv: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
